topic.title: Unstaged Files Area
topic.shortdesc: Review changed files that are not yet part of the next commit.

body.p:
The Unstaged files area lists changed resources that are not part of the next commit. These resources can include modified files, new files, and deleted files.
The contextual menu includes actions such as Open, Open in compare editor, Stage, Discard, Show history, Show blame, Show in Explorer (Show in Finder on macOS), and more.
To stage files, move them to the Staged files area. You can use Stage all to stage all files, or select specific files and use Stage selected.
To switch between the list view and tree view, click the Switch to tree/list view button.
